description: Human auth status with a rejected environment key prints only the error (label, Detail, Action) on stderr and no status line.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: SERVICE_AUTH_REQUIRED: OpenProse service authentication is required.
Detail: the service rejected the API key in OPENPROSE_API_KEY (unknown or revoked); replace or unset OPENPROSE_API_KEY: an environment key takes precedence over `prose cli auth login`
Action: Replace or unset OPENPROSE_API_KEY, then retry.
